title: Step 2 - Preparing Data: Creating Training and Test Sets in Python for ML Models

cues.en: Instructor: All right, so I think I've explained enough.
cues.zh: 好，我想已經解釋得很完整了。

cues.en: Now, we are relieved that at least it's a hundred percent clear for everyone.
cues.zh: 至少現在大家應該都百分之百清楚了。

cues.en: And so there you go, my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，開始吧。

cues.en: Let's implement one of the last tools of this data preprocessing toolkit, which is indeed the split of the data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 現在實作資料前處理工具箱的倒數幾個工具之一：把資料集切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: All right, so how are we going to do this?
cues.zh: 要如何完成？

cues.en: Well, we're gonna do it with a function.
cues.zh: 我們會使用函式。

cues.en: A function by scikit-learn, you know, the most popular and useful data science library because once again, this library contains a module that is called model selection, which contains, itself,
cues.zh: 來自常用又實用的 scikit-learn。這個函式庫有一個 model_selection 模組，裡面提供

cues.en: a function called train_test_split.
cues.zh: train_test_split 函式。

cues.en: And this function will exactly do what we want, which is to create four separate sets, actually not two, but four, because we will actually create a pair of matrix of features dependent variable
cues.zh: 它正好能完成需求，而且實際上不是建立兩份，而是四份資料，因為要分別替訓練集建立一對特徵矩陣與依變數，

cues.en: for the training set, and another pair of matrix of features dependent variable for the test set.
cues.zh: 也替測試集建立另一對。

cues.en: All right, so we're basically going to get four sets, X train, which is the matrix of features of the training set.
cues.zh: 因此會得到四份資料：X_train 是訓練集的特徵矩陣。

cues.en: X test, which is the matrix of features of the test set Y train, which is the dependent variable of the training set, and Y test, which is the dependent variable of the test set.
cues.zh: X_test 是測試集的特徵矩陣，y_train 是訓練集依變數，y_test 則是測試集依變數。

cues.en: That's exactly what we want.
cues.zh: 這正是我們需要的。

cues.en: And now why do we want this?
cues.zh: 為什麼需要這些呢？

cues.en: While it's not us, it's actually the future machinery model that we will build in the next part, which will be all of them expecting this format as input.
cues.zh: 其實不是我們個人需要，而是下一部分要建立的模型，都要求這種輸入格式。

cues.en: You know, for the training, it'll expect X train and Y train as input in a method actually called the fit method.
cues.zh: 訓練時，fit 方法需要傳入 X_train 與 y_train。

cues.en: And for the predictions, also called inference, these models will predict X test.
cues.zh: 預測，也叫推論時，模型會使用 X_test。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 明白嗎？

cues.en: So, that's the reason.
cues.zh: 原因就是這樣。

cues.en: It is simply the format expected by the future machinery models.
cues.zh: 這單純是之後的模型要求的格式。

cues.en: And now let's get these four sets.
cues.zh: 現在建立這四份資料。

cues.en: So, we're gonna get them from scikit-learn, of course.
cues.zh: 當然從 scikit-learn 取得函式。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: From which we're gonna get access to model selection.
cues.zh: 接著存取 model_selection。

cues.en: I really like Google Colab.
cues.zh: 我真的很喜歡 Google Colab。

cues.en: And then from which we're gonna import that train_tests_split function.
cues.zh: 再從這裡匯入 train_test_split。

cues.en: Perfect, you see how we can be so efficient?
cues.zh: 很好，看到了嗎？有這些提示，效率非常高。

cues.en: Thanks to the assistance of Google Colab.
cues.zh: 多虧 Google Colab 的輔助。

cues.en: I hope you really like it as well.
cues.zh: 希望你也喜歡它。

cues.en: All right, so now that we have this function, well, we're gonna use it.
cues.zh: 函式已經匯入，現在使用它。

cues.en: And, since we already know what this function will return, as I've just explained, well, let's create these four variables returned by this train test split function.
cues.zh: 既然知道它會傳回什麼，就先建立它所傳回的四個變數。

cues.en: And as we said, they are first X train, the matrix of features of the training set, therefore containing all the countries, one hot encoded,
cues.zh: 第一個是 X_train，也就是訓練集的特徵矩陣，包含訓練客戶的獨熱編碼國家、

cues.en: ages, and salaries, of the training set.
cues.zh: 年齡與薪資。

cues.en: So X train.
cues.zh: 所以寫 X_train。

cues.en: Then X test, the matrix of features of the test set.
cues.zh: 再來是 X_test，測試集的特徵矩陣。

cues.en: Then Y train, which is the dependent variable of the training set, meaning all the purchase decisions of the customers in the training set, Y train.
cues.zh: 接著是 y_train，訓練集的依變數，也就是訓練集客戶的全部購買決策。

cues.en: And then Y test, which same, contains all the purchase decisions of the customers in the test set.
cues.zh: 最後 y_test，同樣包含測試集客戶的全部購買決策。

cues.en: Alright, so that's the four variables returned by this train_test_split function.
cues.zh: 這就是 train_test_split 傳回的四個變數。

cues.en: And since it is the function that returns this variable, well, let's take that function right away, and let's add here an equals, and train_test_split,
cues.zh: 既然由這個函式傳回，就在這裡加等號，再寫 train_test_split，

cues.en: and then some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 後面加上括號。

cues.en: And now the question is, what do we have to input inside this function?
cues.zh: 現在的問題是，函式裡應該傳入什麼？

cues.en: All right, so, actually, there are some parameters that we can guess, right?
cues.zh: 其實有些參數可以猜得到。

cues.en: Because, indeed, this train_test_split is supposed to split something.
cues.zh: 因為 train_test_split 要切分某些東西。

cues.en: So, one of the input will be that's something which we're about to split, and which is, of course, our data set.
cues.zh: 所以，其中的輸入自然就是要切分的內容，也就是資料集。

cues.en: However, of course, this function does not expect the data set as a whole.
cues.zh: 但它不會接收完整的 dataset 物件。

cues.en: It expects, well, the combination of the matrix of features X, and the dependent variable vector Y.
cues.zh: 而是接收特徵矩陣 X，以及依變數向量 y。

cues.en: And that's the first two inputs of this function.
cues.zh: 這就是函式的前兩個輸入。

cues.en: So, let's input them here, X first, the matrix of features, and Y, the dependent variable vector.
cues.zh: 所以先傳入 X，再傳入 y。

cues.en: Great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Y, yes, then comma, and then next argument.
cues.zh: y，接著逗號，再寫下一個引數。

cues.en: So, we still have to input two more arguments which are going to be first the split size, you know, because we're not going to split this data set
cues.zh: 還有兩個引數要設定，首先是切分比例，因為不會把資料集

cues.en: into a training set and a test set of the same size.
cues.zh: 拆成大小相同的訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Actually, we need a lot of observations in the training set and a few in the test set, but we need a lot of them in the training set, so as to give the future machinery model more chance to understand and learn
cues.zh: 訓練集需要較多觀測值，測試集可以少一些，因為要給模型更多機會，理解並學習

cues.en: the correlations in the data set.
cues.zh: 資料集中的關係。

cues.en: So, let me just tell you the recommended size of the split.
cues.zh: 我直接告訴你建議的比例。

cues.en: Well, I recommend to have 80% observation in the training set, and 20% in the test set.
cues.zh: 我建議訓練集占 80%，測試集占 20%。

cues.en: All right, this is a very good split.
cues.zh: 這是一個很好的切分方式。

cues.en: And therefore, here we are going to input a new parameter which is test_size.
cues.zh: 因此，這裡加入 test_size 參數。

cues.en: And we'll set that equal to 0.2, right?
cues.zh: 把它設為 0.2。

cues.en: 20% observations will go into the test set.
cues.zh: 也就是 20% 的觀測值進入測試集。

cues.en: And therefore here, since we have 10 observations in this data set, that means that eight observations will go into the training set, meaning eight customers will go into the training set and two in the test set.
cues.zh: 目前資料集有十筆觀測值，所以八筆進入訓練集，也就是八位客戶；另外兩筆進入測試集。

cues.en: And this is not necessarily the last two, you know, they will be taken randomly, but eight of them will go into the training set and two in the test set.
cues.zh: 不一定是最後兩筆，因為會隨機抽取，但總共就是八筆訓練、兩筆測試。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now we'll add one final argument just for teaching purposes so that we can have the same results displayed in here, you know, in the notebook.
cues.zh: 最後再加一個引數，純粹是為了教學，讓大家在 Notebook 中看到相同結果。

cues.en: Because then I'm going to run some prints to show you these four elements returned by this train_test_split function.
cues.zh: 因為接下來會用 print，顯示 train_test_split 傳回的四個物件。

cues.en: You know, the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 也就是訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And since there are some random factors that are gonna happen during this split, right?
cues.zh: 切分過程會涉及隨機因素，

cues.en: Because the observations will be randomly split into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 因為觀測值會被隨機分配到訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Well, to make sure we have the same random factors, we'll just set here, random_state = 1, right?
cues.zh: 為了讓隨機結果一致，這裡設定 random_state=1。

cues.en: We're just fixing the seed here so that we'll get the same split and therefore the same training set, and same test set.
cues.zh: 也就是固定隨機種子，讓我們得到相同的切分、訓練集與測試集。
